tenderSchedule.title: FOOD CATERING SERVICES
tenderSchedule.description: Providing Food Catering service in the Karnataka State Higher Education Academy, Dharwad campus during training programs.

tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Satisfactory Experience Certificate in Food Catering Services/Hotel/Hospitality or allied food service business issued by the Govt/Non Govt Organizations/PSUs during Financial Year 2023-24, 2024-25 & 2025-26.

Registration Certificate issued by the Municipal Authority or any other Authority established by the Govt. of India or Karnataka mentioning the business as Food Catering Services/Hotel/Hospitality or allied food service business. Date of Certificate should be on or before 01.10.2023.
G.S.T. Registration certificate. Date of Certificate should be on or before 01.10.2023.
Food License & Registration Certificate issued by Food Safety & Standards Authority of India under FSS Act 2006 and amendment thereon. Date of Certificate should be on or before 01.10.2023.

Registration/License certificate from the Labour and Employment Department mentioning the business as Food Catering Services/Hotel/Hospitality or allied food service business. Date of Certificate should be on or before 01.10.2023.
Registration/License certificate from Employees Provident Fund Organization. Date of Certificate should be on or before 01.10.2023.
Registration/License certificate from Employees State Insurance Corporation. Date of Certificate should be on or before 01.10.2023.
PAN card of Firm/Agency/Trust/Proprietor. Date of registration should be on or before 01.10.2023.

Declaration on Rs.100/- e-stamp paper. Date of e-Stamp paper should be between the date of Tender Notice and Closing of Bidding. Earlier date will not be considered, declaring that A Firm or Agency or Trust or any has not been Blacklisted by any Govt or Non Govt department or PSUs and the owner or partner of the firm agency trust is not involved in any police or judicial case. Staff deploying for the purpose of catering services during the training program should be Manager for overall management. Morning Shift Cook or chef 1 No, Helpers or Service 3 No, Cleaners 1 No, Housekeeping staff 1 No, Afternoon Shift Cook or chef 1 No, Helpers or Service 3 No, Cleaners 1 No, Housekeeping staff 1 No
